UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_NeedFramework: This window needs Minidoracat UI Framework (API rev 18 or later).
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_PreviewHint: Left drag: rotate · right drag: pan · wheel: zoom · double-click: reset
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_PreviewNote: The 3D view shows this vehicle type's default look with every optional part. This vehicle's actual state is in the list above.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_ScriptMissing: The mod of this vehicle type is not loaded.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_CannotDraw: This vehicle type cannot be drawn in 3D.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_OptShowDock: Show the admin panel in the family Dock
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_OptShowDock_tool: Only admins see it. Turn off to hide the Pack & Throw button from the Dock.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_CAR_EXISTS: The server has the recorded vehicle loaded: it is still in the world.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_CHECK_SITE: Go to the spot first, then tick "I checked on site".
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_NOT_RESTORAB: This record cannot be restored in its current state.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_NOT_UNCERTAI: This record is no longer unconfirmed.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_BLOCKED: Nothing can appear on the chosen spot (not loaded or blocked). Pick another spot.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_PICK_BLOCKED: It does not fit on the chosen spot. Pick another one.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_BAD_SPOT: The chosen spot is not valid. Pick it again.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_IN_TRADE: This capsule is in an Economy trade (listed or up for auction). Cancel the listing or wait for the auction to end first.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_SCRIPT_MISSI: This vehicle type no longer exists (was its mod removed?).
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_NO_SNAPSHOT: There is no record file for this capsule.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_WRITE_FAILED: The server could not write the record file.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_BAD_TRANSITI: This change is not allowed in the current state.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_ERROR: Server error; see the server log.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_SearchHint: Capsule number or player, e.g. 10023114, Bob
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_NoteHint: Note (optional), e.g. reissued the water bottles
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_PickRecord: Pick a record on the left.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_UncertainHelp: check on site: still there = close it, gone = restorable
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_CarLoaded: vehicle #%1 is loaded on the server
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_RestoreConfirm: Restore %1 at (%2, %3)? It comes back without cargo (the record lists it), and the old capsule can never be unpacked afterwards.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_LootNote: Only containers opened for the first time afterwards are affected; containers already looted do not respawn. The numbers go straight into the vanilla loot tables. Which types drop is set on the Types tab: the dropping capsules share a capsule place's weight evenly, Pal Spheres a sphere place's by tier rarity 8:4:2:1.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_NoSandboxRight: You need the sandbox options permission to change these.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_LootApplied: Changes sent: %1. The server updates the loot tables within a second.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_SettingsNote: Same values as this mod's pages in the vanilla sandbox options; they take effect as soon as the server receives them.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_TypeUseTip: Off: players cannot use this type (capsules pack vehicles, Pal Spheres catch animals). Loaded ones still throw and unpack, or release. While off, it cannot be crafted either.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_TypeLootTip: On: empty ones of this type turn up in loot. Capsules share each capsule place's weight evenly; Pal Spheres share each sphere place's weight by tier rarity.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_TypeListTip: Opens a product draft for this empty capsule in the Economy Center shop; set the price there.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_TypeListNoEconom: Needs Minidoracat Economy to list it.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_TypePreviewTip: Throws one of this type beside you. Only you see it, and it works before you apply.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_TypeOffLine: Off: cannot pack a vehicle, catch an animal or be crafted; loaded ones still work
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_TypesNote: Loot: the %1 types that are on drop (capsules share the capsule places evenly, Pal Spheres the sphere places by tier rarity 8:4:2:1). Places and weights are on the Loot tab.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_TypesNoteNone: No type turns up in loot now.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_CraftGroupCapsul: Capsules (at one difficulty, all seven take the same parts)
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_CraftGroupSphere: Pal Spheres (each tier above the first upgrades an empty one of the tier below)
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_CraftOffLine: Disabled: the crafting window neither lists nor finds it
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_CraftTypeOff: Off in the Types tab: never in the crafting window
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_CraftNote: Recipes that are not disabled are listed in the crafting window's "Pack & Throw" category (the capsule icon in Neat Crafting's left column) and need a table or workbench and light; for each type, players see only the difficulty picked. Point at a difficulty to preview its recipe. Once applied, crafting windows players already have open switch to the new list within a few seconds.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_ShopOpened: Opened a product draft for %1 in the Economy Center. Set its price and apply it there.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_ShopOpen_forbidd: You do not have Economy Center admin rights.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_ShopOpen_unavail: The Economy Center admin window is not ready; try again later.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_ShopOpen_other: The Economy Center did not open the product draft.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_RestoreAnimalCon: Restore %1 at (%2, %3)? The old Pal Sphere can never release it afterwards.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_AnimalLoaded: animal #%1 is near its recorded spot on the server
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_AnimalNotLoaded: animal #%1 is not near its recorded spot
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_ANIMAL_EXIST: The recorded animal is still near its recorded spot: it is still in the world.
UI_MinidoracatPackThrow_Why_SAFEHOUSE: The chosen spot is in someone else's safehouse. Pick another one.
